## ABOUT US

RV College of Engineering (RVCE), established in 1963, stands as one of India’s earliest self-financing engineering colleges, run by Rashtreeya Sikshana Samithi Trust (RSST).

What started with just 3 engineering branches has grown into a vibrant institution offering 13 undergraduate, 13 postgraduate and doctoral programmes.

Nestled on a 16.85-acre campus along Mysore Road, RVCE offers an environment where learning, innovation and creativity thrive. With highly qualified faculty conducting R&D for both industry and defence, the college welcomes over 2,000 students every year and continues to be synonymous with innovation and engineering brilliance.

content: R.V College of Engineering Bengaluru - 560 059 RVE/ ACCTS/ 92/ /2026-2027 Date: 28.09.2026 CIRCULAR:HigherSemesterUGStudents This is tobring to thekind attentionofallBE students of the 2ndyear(3rdsemester),3rdyear(5th semester), and 4th year (7th semester), as well as the respective Heads of Departments, that the last date for payment of fees, previously fixed as 25.09.2026, has been extended up to 10.10.2026. This extension is being provided as several students have not remitted their fees within the stipulated time to the prescribed bank accounts, as detailed in the earlier circular. As fee payment is linked to various academic services, including the issuance of certificates, generation of hall tickets, and eligibility to appear for practical and theory examinations, all students are advised toclear their dues within the extended deadline to avoid any inconvenience or disruption to their academic activities. This circular serves as a gentle and final reminder to all students to remit their fees on or before 10.10.2026 without fail. No further extension will be granted. 1.InstructionsforStudentsWhoHavePaidThroughNEFT/RTGS Ithasbeenobservedthatseveralstudentswhohaveremitted theirfees throughNEFT/RTGShavenot submitted their payment details to the Accounts Section for receipt generation. Further, in certain cases, the payment details furnished by students do not match the transactions reflected in the bank statement. Accordingly, students who have paid their fees through NEFT/RTGS but whose receipts are not available in the SAP student portal are hereby instructed to contact the Student Fee Section,Accounts Department, with the relevant payment proof, including the UTR/reference number, transaction date, and amountpaid,tofacilitateverificationandgenerationof thefeereceipt. Students whose fee receipts are already available in the SAP student portal may ignore this instruction. 2. Instructions for Students Whose Fees Have Been Paid Through Education Loans Students whose education loan amounts have been disbursed directly by the bank to the college account are requested to check their SAP student portal for thefee receipt. If the receipt is not available in the portal, such students shall contact the Student Fee Section, Accounts Department, and submit the relevant proof of disbursement issued by the bank to facilitate verification andgeneration of thefeereceipt. 3.Importantinformation toHeadsof Departments All Heads of Departments are requested to ensure that the higher-semester UG students of their respectivedepartments remit theirfeeswithintheprescribed deadline. After 10.10.2026, the respective departments shall submit the list of students who have not paid their fees to the undersigned. Such students shall not be permitted to attend classes, appear for examinations, or participate in any academic activities until all outstanding dues are cleared. All concerned are requested to take note of the above and ensure strict compliance. PRINCIPAL 2819 RVCBRgeCdPAigineering Bangalore - 560 059 Copy to: 2910g 1. The academic excellence at RVCE is reflected in its student’s exemplary record in placements in the corporate and engineering sectors. RVCE has consistently maintained an excellent recruitment record. The graduates and post- graduates of RVCE have been recruited by some of the world’s leading corporate, besides leading Indian companies. The sheer diversity of Indian economy and society, whose different shades are represented among the students and faculty, prepares the students to work in global multicultural corporations / industries with following agenda.

- To assist the development of graduates with balanced set of technical skills, interpersonal skills and with a positive attitude to life.
- To act as a nodal agency in the Institution for forging technology. alliance between the Departments of RVCE and the Industries.
- To act as a seamless conduit between the Industry and the Institute and provide quality technical manpower to suit every organizational need

###### Vision

Sustained Excellence in Training, Placement and Career Guidance

###### Mission

- To develop the Department of placement & training as a single window nodal point for career counselling and Higher learning in Engineering & Technology fields
- To set up the Training Infrastructure for conducting value added training programs and enhance the employability of students
- To institute the best practices in conducting and co-ordinating the campus placement process for the industries in the institution
- To acquire the services of competent training agencies to train the students in soft skills and personality development programme.

## ABOUT the Department

The Department of placement & training was established as a separate entity in the year 1997. The Department presently coordinates with more than 200 leading organizations which recruits Engineers/Techno crafts and GET/ PGET’s for entry level positions in their respective organizations.

In the year of inception, the department modestly established contact with about 30 organizations and placed 140 numbers of students. With every passing year, the number of recruiting organizations have increased in geometric progression on an average about 200 nationally renowned organization visiting the campus annually & conduct their recruitment process in our campus and 1200 offers have been made by 178 companies / Organization for 2016 passing out batch.

The independent placement & training block in the first floor of the Administrative block has been built with a view to provide the complete autonomy and convenience for executives to conduct fair and transparent talent search to recruit good quality engineers for positions in organizations. The Department has set up all the required facilities for the conduction of the recruitment process such as seminar hall for company presentations, group discussion rooms and conferencing facilities, interview and discussion rooms.

### Soft Skill Training Programme

The Training Programme which is being offered at the institutional level and being facilitated by the Department of Training & Placement is aimed at orienting the students with life skills. Career orientation is achieved by training the students on the skills needed for a career in the corporate through a total of 72 Hours of Training on the different dimensions of development of individuals. The programme is spread over the 2 nd & 3 rd year of the Bachelors Degree programme and involves 36 hours of Training by our partners rich in experience & sound on the knowledge & skills of the pedagogical aspects of personality orientation & development.

### Value-added Activities

The Department of Placement & Training is recognized for its ability to plan and implement value added programs such as the Personality development programs, Technology Training Programs and Bridge Courses in the areas of interest and requirements for the Industry. This adds to the credentials of the students and builds the quality of the engineering professionals from the college.

Placement & Training Department is also providing necessary Pre-Placement Training for the pre- final year students in the form of Pre-Placement talks arranged by various industries / corporate, training from the seniors on nature of the written test being imparted and process of interview of different industries. Placement Department also regularly organizes talks from the various professionals from different universities for pursuing higher education in abroad and talks from trainers for taking competitive exams like CAT, GMAT, Aptitude etc.

### Career Guidance & Higher Education

The Department of Placement & Training is a nodal agency for providing inputs on career opportunities for higher studies. Many international universities visit the campus and placement & training department facilitates in conducting orientation and counselling on higher education opportunities. In addition to the placement activities, the Department involves in mentoring students for opportunities in higher education, entrepreneurship and internship

### Scholarship

The Department also engages with the corporate to offer scholarship to students on merit cum means basis. The scholarship to the tune of Rs.72,00,000/- is instituted with approximately 110 beneficiaries (The scholarship agencies are ABB, CTS, FFE, Devon, Boeing etc)

## Infrastructure & Facilities

Placement office has total 739 Sq. mts floor area, consisting of 1 Seminar Hall of 70 seating capacity with audio video facilities, Placement officer’s room, pantry room, staff room, reception area, Library, 6 interview rooms, 2 Group Discussion Rooms. Video Conferencing facility in the department is also under consideration and proposals have already been received from the suppliers.

The Department of Placement & Training is headed by a teaching faculty Dr. D Ranganath, Dean of Placement and Training with the background of vast teaching experience and Industry exposure guides the activities in the department. The department has a full time staff who interacts with the industry on a day to day basis and provides quick response to the communications received. The department of placement & training is fully networked with LAN networking configuration houses computers and peripherals for routine office work. Provisions are made for connectivity using wireless and wired network configuration with 22 data points. Wifi technology has been implemented in the seminar hall and the conference room. Placement office is enabled with exclusive internet connectivity to provide for a quick response. The concept of office automation is fully implemented in the placement office to ensure work productivity.
